actual_audit.scope: actual TPG event, semantic guard, measured support and final pose audit; idealized contact/connection and sampled collision models remain limitations

certificate.scope: Current supplied node paths: sampled all-phase moving conflicts; refreshed scheduling, continuous-run gates and full world/waiting-state verification remain required.

geometry_audit.scope: Fresh sampled swept-path oracle plus full nominal world-state/idle rollout; not continuous collision certification.

curved_geometry_audit.scope: Curve count is derived from actual TPG; zero or varying counts are supported

command_bound_audit.scope: Analytic commanded-profile extrema/control-hull bounds, not measured physical jerk certification
